notes.text: TRIAGED (source review 2026-08-09, confidence high): The tile plane is right: md5translate.trs-resolved per-ADT minimap BLPs drawn as a continuous 3x3 neighborhood under a fixed player arrow, 6 zoom steps on wheel + the authored ZoomIn/ZoomOut buttons, circular mask/cluster art, zone detection from ADT area ids driving CMSG_ZONEUPDATE, the tracking button (active tracking aura icon in the MiniMap-TrackingBorder, right-click cancels), the mail icon, party dots, and a resource-node dot layer gated on PLAYER_TRACK_RESOURCES with a GO-template-named hover tooltip through the shared GameTooltip lifecycle. But most of Benilla's byte-verified blip and interior law is absent.
